title: Winter questions for a small harbour

exploration.question: How does the harbour keep a ferry sailing through the winter

branches.prompt: Where does the ferry tie up when the harbour ices over
What fuel does the boat burn in the cold months
branches.finding: The boat burns winter grade diesel from the harbour tank

branches.prompt: How often does the boat sail in January
Where is the winter diesel stored ashore
branches.finding: Two heated tanks stand behind the harbour office

branches.prompt: Does the boat sail after dark in midwinter
branches.reason: The harbour bylaw settles the sailing hours already

branches.prompt: Where does the crew rest between sailings

exploration.question: Who answers a call for help on the water in winter

branches.prompt: How does a call for help reach the lifeboat crew
How does the boat get down the slipway on ice
branches.finding: The slipway is gritted and the tractor is kept fuelled

branches.prompt: What seas can the boat go out in
How does the crew get word back to shore
branches.reason: The radio drill in the spring log already answers this

exploration.question: Which harbour lights stay lit through the winter nights
